title: Non-Degenerate Risk Certification for Automated Security Decisions: A Decision-Contract Theory with ATT\&CK-Aligned Triage as a Worked Instance
abstract: arXiv:2608.12444v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An unconditional risk bound on automated decisions can be satisfied without automating anything, since a selector that never acts drives the bound to zero. We show this is structural: any risk certificate is defined over a decision contract, the inputs a system acts on plus the semantic relation under which an output counts correct, and weakening either hides base-classifier error. We develop a decision-contract theory: an error-conservation law showing error is only reassigned among harmful automation, human deferral, and semantic masking; a label-free singleton capacity certifying structural incapacity, with a risk-feasible refinement separating recoverable threshold misalignment from risk-constrained incapacity; and a non-degenerate actionability certificate excluding all-abstain solutions by construction. We instantiate this on ATT\&CK-aligned alert triage for LLM-based intrusion detection, the setting that exposed the vacuity fail

translated_title: 非退化自动化安全决策风险认证：一种决策契约理论及其在ATT&CK对齐分流中的实例应用
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12444v1公告类型：交叉 摘要：对自动化决策的无条件风险界限可以在不自动化任何内容的情况下满足，因为一个从不行动的选通器会将界限降至零。我们表明这是结构性的：任何风险证书都是基于决策契约定义的，即系统作用的输入加上输出被视为正确的语义关系，削弱任一因素都会隐藏基分类器的错误。我们发展了一种决策契约理论：一个误差守恒定律，显示误差仅在有害自动化、人类延迟和语义掩盖之间重新分配；一个无标签的单例容量，证明结构性无能力，并带有风险可行的细化，区分可恢复的阈值错位和风险约束下的无能力；以及一个非退化的可操作性证书，通过构造排除所有放弃的解决方案。我们将其实例化于基于LLM的入侵检测的ATT&CK对齐警报分流，这一设置暴露了空洞性失败。
tldr: 本文提出一种决策契约理论，通过误差守恒定律和非退化可操作性证书，确保自动化安全决策的风险认证不会因“不行动”而空洞满足，并在LLM入侵检测的ATT&CK分流中实例化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a decision-contract theory with an error-conservation law and a non-degenerate actionability certificate, ensuring risk certification for automated security decisions cannot be vacuously satisfied by inaction, instantiated on ATT&CK-aligned triage for LLM-based intrusion detection.
